from_speaker: will crush the life out of the company
our_interpretation: The company is CoreWeave and October means October 2025.
October dates the payments. The sentence supplies no deadline for the resulting harm.
The ordinary reading is financial collapse or severe financial distress materially caused by those payment obligations, rather than merely interest expense, losses or a falling share price.
This is an unconditional prediction about asserted obligations, not an if-then forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records establish collapse or severe financial distress and materially connect it to the loan payments identified as due in October 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive record establishes that the identified payment burden was fully discharged or extinguished without the predicted distress or continuing consequences capable of producing it. Continued operation alone is insufficient.
